items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We played with them. They had drum, bass, and the piano and maybe two horns.

ctx.x: Trumpet, bass trumpet player from New Orleans, yeah. Punch Miller and they had Jimmy [Unintelligible] was the clarinet player.

And these were small combos, playing in basement level places, small clubs where it was just a piano, [unintelligible] on that piano. We played with them. They had drum, bass, and the piano and maybe two horns.
